# KARTIK H

> M.Pharm (Pharmacy Practice) scholar and builder working on how healthcare knowledge
> becomes understanding, decisions, and better outcomes. Pharmacist by training; directs AI
> models across the build lifecycle rather than writing production code as a discipline.

KARTIK H is a pharmacist and independent builder based in Koppal, Karnataka, India, pursuing
an M.Pharm in Pharmacy Practice at RIPER, Anantapur (JNTUA) — an autonomous campus. His work
sits where pharmacy practice, health communication, and digital health meet. The question
behind everything: how can healthcare knowledge be communicated, organised, and translated
into understanding that helps people make better decisions and improves health outcomes?

Key facts: name written "KARTIK H"; residence Koppal, Karnataka; campus Anantapur, Andhra
Pradesh; languages Kannada (native), English (professional), Hindi (fluent), Telugu and Tamil
(conversational); seven certifications plus a B.Pharm degree; the Healthcare Knowledge Essays
(#01–#20 published, Books I and II complete).

## Projects

- [PMAS](https://github.com/kartik-h6/PMAS): pharmacist-led medication and adherence support — offline-first, five-language telepharmacy platform. Research instrument first, product second.
- [e-library](https://github.com/kartik-h6/e-library): semester-wise B.Pharm study library on the PCI 2026 (NEP 2020) syllabus.
- [digital-setup](https://github.com/kartik-h6/digital-setup): bilingual digital-services site for local businesses (TECHSTUDYHUBCORE).
- [techstudyhubcore-archive](https://github.com/kartik-h6/techstudyhubcore-archive): the archived engineering record of the TechStudyHubCore ecosystem.
- [Portfolio](https://kartik-h6.github.io/Portfolio/): the professional identity site.
